fonte: Los Angeles County Public Works (annexation records)
legenda: Before the strip: 43 sq mi, about 19 miles from Wilmington.
texto_para_tela: ABOUT 19 MILES · 43 SQ MI · the city before the strip
credito_tela: Source: Los Angeles County annexation records
nota: 43,26 mi² na camada 21 (relida hoje) e no quadro de Hamlin; a medida sobre a folha dá 42,79.
narracao: Los Angeles, nineteen miles away, had won a harbor it did not touch. Winning the bay was not having it. Look at the outline before the strip: forty-three square miles, well to the north. The harbor sits inside San Pedro and Wilmington. To merge with San Pedro and Wilmington, Los Angeles had to touch them.
